title: Formbricks file
description: A Formbricks survey exported as a file. Import it into any Formbricks workspace, organization or instance.

__schema1.description: The file format. Formbricks refuses a format newer than its own.

__schema3.description: The Formbricks version that wrote the file.

surveyId.description: The id of the survey this file was exported from.

workspaceId.description: The id of the workspace the survey belonged to.

updatedAt.description: When the survey was last changed before the export, to detect later edits.

__schema99.description: The survey's address for the field: logic operands name it. Optional; defaults to a new cuid2 (computed) or the name / library key (ingested).

__schema101.description: A workspace library key, to link that library field; its definition is filled in from the library. null or omitted declares a local field.

__schema103.description: Display name. Required for a local field; for an ingested one also the URL parameter.

__schema105.description: computed: set by logic (Set value). ingested: read from the URL or the SDK. Required for a local field.

__schema107.description: string (default), number, boolean or date. A computed field is string, number or date.

__schema109.description: Initial value (computed) or fallback when nothing arrives (ingested), matching dataType; a date is ISO 8601. Defaults to null.

__schema113.description: Ingested fields only: true ignores what the URL or SDK sends and always uses defaultValue. Defaults to false.

__schema122.description: Survey custom CSS source: `{ light, dark }`, both keys required, each a CSS string or null. Light applies in both appearances, dark adds overrides. null clears both. Source only — compiled output is computed by the server.

FormbricksFileReferences.description: What the survey points at outside itself, so it works in a workspace that lacks them.
